name: v116 logged-action playback for decision-time service observability
purpose: Recover missing current native information at two already-exposed connection states; test observability only, not policy improvement.

cases.trace: v114 parent prefix plus low suffix
cases.reason: Connection vehicle leaves two seconds before the known transfer arrival in this realized trajectory.
Current eligible queue is zero despite a later realized transfer from another active vehicle.

execution.action_path: Return the recorded proposed action through the original F; compare every issue identity/raw state/executed action against the closed original trace.
execution.stop: Inspect before the named action is applied, then stop without pretending to finish the day or fabricating terminal labels.
execution.native_rng: No assumed equivalence from action replay alone: any trace/state mismatch stops the diagnostic, retaining actual cost without retry or alternative root.
execution.metadata: Reuse resident history_metadata.json contract and station_max_by_line; no learner/checkpoint restoration.
execution.ledger_check: Reconstruct accumulated W/R at each issue clock from retained tick-start waiting/in_vehicle and dt; actions alone do not contain this ledger. Compare in place on server.

observations: native clock and receiver identity, current physical location, speed, stop/next-stop plan, free seats and service-ready status
active feeder identity/current location/speed/next-stop plan and current native onboard membership
current person stage0 type/line/destStop; distinguish this from whole-journey transfer metadata
separate presence/availability of already-known planned transfer intent from realized future boarding or arrival
excluded_inputs: future queue or final person status
unborn passenger route demand as a current observation
unlogged ETA reconstructed from future visit rows
advance_gate: Complete playback identity and state checks plus genuine issue-before-apply observability. This only admits later design of a single fixed candidate; it is not a control-benefit gate.
unchanged_gates: Any later controller still requires the original matched no_fresh and same-actor frozen MC-WM full-day cost gates.
